paper.authors: Lichao Cao and Mingwei Ge and Xiaoxia Gao and Bowen Du and Baoliang Li and Zhi Huang and Yongqian Liu
paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization to Minimize the Wake-Induced Turbulence Effect on Wind Turbines

paper_source_conflicts: Zhuanghe prose states two 2.3 MW turbines, while Fig. 19 labels GW121/3000 and only two 3.0 MW turbines produce the stated 303.15 MW total.
missing_information: complete NSGA-II controls and repeat count
Zhuanghe original coordinates and numerical wind arrays
raw Pareto fronts and optimizer traces
completion_decisions: Use paper Eqs. (1)-(18) for the coupled MTG velocity and added-turbulence evaluator.
Use eight deterministic equal-area rotor samples for the Eq. (15) area average and turbine-level Eq. (11) value.
Digitize Case-II probabilities and Zhuanghe wind direction and turbulence curves from Figs. 9, 20 and 21.
Use a shape-2 Weibull law constrained to the paper mean 6.9 m/s and six midpoint bins for Zhuanghe wind speed.
Use the self-consistent GW121/3000 rating, CT=0.8, and declared cubic-to-rating Zhuanghe curves.
Use standard Deb SBX and polynomial mutation with population 100, twenty generations, and 25 seeds.
Implement all three paper problems; comparison methods are excluded.

decision_variables.resolution: continuous x-y coordinates; Zhuanghe also permits three turbine types with fixed counts 2,49,21

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: real coordinate vector with immutable turbine-type labels; coordinate movement explores type placement while preserving counts

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize probability-weighted farm power and minimize maximum turbine comprehensive inflow streamwise turbulence

constraints_and_repair.resolution: ideal square plus >5D spacing; exact Zhuanghe piecewise boundary plus >4 max(Di,Dj); deterministic rejection repair

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: Li added-turbulence model, maximum-wake turbulence superposition, MTG velocity model, rotor average, Katic RSS, ideal cubic power and declared Zhuanghe cubic-to-rating curves

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: Case I one state; Case II 36 directions by 3 speeds; Zhuanghe 16 directions by 6 Weibull midpoint bins with speed-dependent ambient turbulence

initialization.resolution: feasible deterministic lattices followed by counter-keyed perturbation and constraint repair

update_order.resolution: rank and crowding, binary tournament, SBX, polynomial mutation, repair, evaluation, parent-offspring merge, elitist environmental selection

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 100 initial complete-layout evaluations plus 20 generations of 100 offspring = 2100 physical FES per run

parameters.resolution: paper physical parameters; population 100, generations 20, SBX p=0.9 eta=20, polynomial mutation p=1/(2N) eta=20

paper_native_cases.resolution: ideal Cases I and II plus 72-turbine Zhuanghe

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: Pareto-front power and maximum comprehensive turbulence, timings, physical FES, science hashes, and 25 independent seeds per case

scope.claim_boundary: academic paper-equation and figure-reconstructed reproduction of NSGA-II and all three paper problems; not author source, private arrays, random states or numerical replay
